push.body:
BellyTb1, your 2nd worst match performance of the season: 6.3. Hard nights build hard players.

THE GOOD
+ Man of the Match, your 15th for us. Everybody wants to play with someone who plays like that.
+ Giveaways 0, down from your usual 8. Small wins add up to big ones.
+ Part of a 3-0 beating of 6 Half Pints. Put that in the team scrapbook.
+ Missed tackles 0, from 6 in your previous match. Keep stacking those bricks.

THE BAD
- No shots. Bread and butter: Ask for it early in the half-space, where a first-time finish is on. You know you can.
- On-ball actions 2, down from your usual 33. We need more from you there, and I know you've got it.
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 3. Let's turn that around by next session.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. We'll drill that till it's boring.

THE UGLY

Skills corner: Get across your defender at the near post. Most close-range goals come from that first-post run.

Last thing, BellyTb1. Taking on a challenge is a lot like riding a horse. Comfortable is overrated.

The best is ahead of you. - Coach Lasso

+ Giveaways 0, down from your usual 8. Remember that the next time you doubt yourself.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 3. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.
